_help: The one set of cost gains for every gearbox type (gearbox_runner.build reads it). The optimiser's cost is K_Mass*mass + K_Eff*efficiency + K_Width*(planet face widths) + |gear ratio - requested| (+ K_torque_shortfall*(1 - torque carried) for ISSPG, ICPG and INWPG, whose face width can be capped). K_Width_real is used only by the actuator map (tools/actuator_map): its second score uses the whole actuator's width, with the driver mount, instead of the planet face widths.
